title: promptctl's directory and glob lookups miss a PR merge commit that changes a directory through different files from each parent
problem: test_promptctl.LastChangeIndexTest.test_lookups_without_a_git_call_match_the_per_file_call failed twice on PR #19644's `validate` job (job 140357845584, 2026-11-27 06:52 UTC) for path='prompts/' and 'prompts/runs/*.json': index ' (file last changed on or before 2026-11-26, the shallow-clone edge)' against git's ' (file last changed 2026-11-27)', '2026-11-27T06:48:55Z' (the merge commit). prompts-ci checks out refs/pull/N/merge at fetch-depth 2. The PR added one run record and main had merged other run records since the branch's base, so the merge commit differs from BOTH parents under prompts/ (git log -1 -- prompts/ names it: directory-level TREESAME), yet differs from neither parent in any single file, so `--diff-merges=c` lists no file for it and _dir_hit/_glob_hit fall through to a shallow root. Any PR that adds a run record while main has newer ones can hit it; P094 (different-day roots) was a different case.
evidence: PR #19644 validate job 140357845584 log: Tuples differ for path='prompts/' and path='prompts/runs/*.json'
Reproduced: git fetch --depth=2 origin refs/pull/19644/merge; merge 450fd04b dated 06:48:55 with parents e04a988c (main) and de03581f (PR head), both shallow roots
change: For merge commits, collect the per-parent changed files (`--diff-merges=separate`, or `git diff --name-only` per parent for the few merges a shallow clone holds) and let _dir_hit/_glob_hit date a directory or glob by a merge whose every parent differs somewhere under it, as git's directory TREESAME does. Add a test with a temp repo: two shallow roots, each adding a different file under one directory, merged. Workaround meanwhile: merge main into the PR branch before pushing the run record.
metric: validate failures of this test on PRs in the 14 days after merge
baseline: 1 PR seen (PR #19644, 2026-11-27), deterministic for its merge ref

history.note: promptctl._merge_hit: _dir_hit/_glob_hit date a directory or glob by the newest merge whose every parent differs somewhere under it (one memoised `git diff --name-only` per parent; main squashes, so only a PR merge ref holds merges). Test: temp repo at depth 2 and 5, merge adding d/m.txt via main and d/p.txt via the PR.
